# The True Vine (John 15:5)

## Emotional Focus
Staying close to Jesus so we can grow.

## Key KJV
“I am the vine, ye are the branches.” (John 15:5)

## Gentle Retelling
Jesus said He is the vine and we are the branches. When we stay close to Him we grow and bear good fruit.

## Coloring Prompt
A strong vine with healthy green branches and sweet grapes.

## Read-along flow + response
“Stay close to Jesus and you will grow strong.”
